cells.gaps: No share or count of communes connected or working in a national system is published: Butihinda is the one commune held working in AK-SOFT (BDI-009), and its staff report the need for a stable Internet connection, so how its office is connected is not stated. Rumonge's routers were announced on 19 July 2024 and not reported delivered (BDI-001, BDI-004). The authorities facts disagree: none on the government fibre link in February 2021 (BDI-007), one commune announced in 2024 (BDI-004), and not published in 2020 and July 2026 (BDI-005, BDI-006); the newest stands.
cells.note: Stage 3 under the study's rule on work in a national system: Butihinda commune, outside the capital, was entering its revenue and spending into AK-SOFT, the communal financial platform the Primature trained communal finance officers on in October 2026, which is also the advancing event. Stage 4 needs more than half of local governments connected on a share or a count with its total, and none is held.
